copy_path.description: Make a copy of a file or folder somewhere else in Dropbox.
copy_path.name: copy_path

parameters.description: The path of the file or folder to copy, for example /Templates/contract.docx.
parameters.name: from_path

parameters.description: Where to put the copy, including its name, for example /Clients/Acme/contract.docx.
parameters.name: to_path

parameters.description: If something already has that path, add a number to the copy's name instead of failing.
parameters.name: autorename

returns.description: Response envelope; the payload is in the "path" field.

path.description: The path of the new copy in Dropbox.

create_folder.description: Create a new folder in Dropbox.
create_folder.name: create_folder

parameters.description: The path for the new folder (e.g., /Documents/NewFolder).
parameters.name: folder_path

parameters.description: Automatically rename if a folder with the same name exists.
parameters.name: autorename

returns.description: Response envelope; the payload is in the "path" field.

path.description: The display path of the created folder.

delete_path.description: Delete a file or folder from Dropbox.
delete_path.name: delete_path

parameters.description: The path of the file or folder to delete, for example /folder/file.txt.
parameters.name: target_path

returns.description: Response envelope; the payload is in the "deleted" field.

deleted.description: True if the deletion was successful.

download_file.description: Download a file from Dropbox and save it to a location you choose.
download_file.name: download_file

parameters.description: The Dropbox path of the file to download.
parameters.name: dropbox_path

parameters.description: Where to save the downloaded file. If left blank, a temporary folder is used.
parameters.name: destination_path

returns.description: Response envelope; the payload is in the "path" field.

path.description: The local path where the file was saved.

list_folder.description: List the contents of a Dropbox folder.
list_folder.name: list_folder

parameters.description: The Dropbox folder to list. Leave blank for the top level of your Dropbox.
parameters.name: folder_path

parameters.description: Set to true to also include files inside subfolders.
parameters.name: recursive

parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 200).
parameters.name: limit

returns.description: Response envelope; the payload is in the "entries" field.

entries.description: List of file and folder paths in the directory.

move_path.description: Move a file or folder to another place in Dropbox, or rename it by giving it a new name in the same folder.
move_path.display_name: Move or rename file or folder
move_path.name: move_path

parameters.description: The path of the file or folder to move, for example /Inbox/report.pdf.
parameters.name: from_path

parameters.description: Where it should end up, including its name, for example /Archive/report.pdf.
parameters.name: to_path

parameters.description: If something already has the new path, add a number to the name instead of failing.
parameters.name: autorename

returns.description: Response envelope; the payload is in the "path" field.

path.description: The new path of the file or folder in Dropbox.

search_files.description: Find files and folders in Dropbox by name or by the words inside them.
search_files.name: search_files

parameters.description: The words to look for, for example invoice 2026.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Only search inside this folder, for example /Clients. Leave blank to search all of your Dropbox.
parameters.name: folder_path

parameters.description: Match only file and folder names, not the words inside files.
parameters.name: filename_only

parameters.description: Maximum number of matches to return (default 100, at most 1000).
parameters.name: limit

returns.description: Response envelope; the payload is in the "entries" field.

entries.description: Paths of the files and folders that matched.

upload_file.description: Upload a file to Dropbox at the location you choose.
upload_file.name: upload_file

parameters.description: The file to upload to Dropbox.
parameters.name: file_path

parameters.description: The destination path in Dropbox (e.g., /folder/file.txt).
parameters.name: dropbox_path

parameters.description: Automatically rename the file if one with the same name already exists.
parameters.name: autorename

returns.description: Response envelope; the payload is in the "path" field.

path.description: The display path of the uploaded file in Dropbox.

description: Upload, download, and organize content in Dropbox.

dropbox_new_file_trigger.description: Runs when a new file is added to Dropbox

parameters.description: The Dropbox folder path to watch (e.g. /Invoices). Leave blank to watch the whole account.
parameters.name: folder_path

parameters.description: Only trigger for files whose name contains this text. Leave blank to match any file.
parameters.name: name_pattern
